title: Integrated small-library synthesis, MS-triggered purification, DMSO stock prep and TR-FRET testing
summary: A fast loop from synthesis to biochemical read: up to 48 compounds per run are made in vials on a synthesiser, purified by MS-triggered prep-HPLC with concentration from charged-aerosol detection, dried in 96-well plates, taken up in DMSO, serially diluted and screened by TR-FRET. Turn-around was 15-30 h versus 7-10 days conventionally.

steps.text: Run amide (acylation) or Buchwald coupling reactions for up to 48 compounds in 4 mL vials on an automated microwave synthesiser.
Purify crude products by MS-triggered preparative HPLC.
Measure concentration of each purified fraction with a charged aerosol detector.
Transfer fractions to 96-well plates (two aliquots per compound: bioassay and NMR purity) and dry on a vacuum evaporator.
Dissolve dried compound to 10 mM in DMSO.
Make 11-point, 3-fold serial dilutions in a 384-well plate.
Run the TR-FRET binding assay (EED target) and read on an EnVision plate reader.

duration_s.note: Whole 22-member amide loop (synthesis to assay result) stated as 15 h; attached here as an end-to-end figure.

equipment.name: Chemspeed SWAVE microwave synthesiser (SWING XL suggested as nearest catalog item)

materials: Acids, amines, aryl halides, DMSO, EED TR-FRET reagents
safety: Microwave synthesis and prep-HPLC solvents: ventilated area.
notes: Step 7 duration is end-to-end loop time, not the read time. Catalog id is a nearest match, not the paper's instrument.
